about_the_game:
The Horseman has returned to terrorize the four kingdoms once again! Take the fight to him by opening the Warchest of the Horseman Hunters and claiming your exclusive monster ally!

This DLC Includes

• One "Malice Crystal" key item which allows Ruby to summon a new Imp ally to her team at will.

About the Malice Crystal

This new Imp ally comes ready to fight with a brand new exclusive class - "Chaotic Soul"! Unlike other classes in the game, Chaotic Soul has a higher than normal Evasion Rate, some Magic Reflection, and a permanent MP/TP recharge effect every turn! This pet class also allows the use of Skills, Magic, Daggers, Wands, General Armor, and General Accessories! This class focuses on dealing Fire, Poison, Dark, Soul, and Ghost type damage - perfect for taking on the Horseman's army!

Additionally, Ruby's new Imp ally is able to access the Black Mage, Saboteur and other roles automatically. Use the Malice Crystal listed under Key Items to summon the Imp, dismiss it, or even change its nickname!

In-Game Requirements

  • Ruby must be able to access Brandywine Forest from the World Map. This happens after the second visit to the Veil from Auria.

  • The first few quests of Team HH in Brandywine Forest must be completed to unlock their Hunter Lodge and access the physical chest which will unlock as long as Steam confirms DLC ownership.

  • Taking part in Class trials will temporarily remove this and all other pets from the party.

  • Interactions that remove Ruby from the party also remove all of her pets. They are returned once Ruby rejoins the party.
